subject: Order form: pricing slabs, multi-entity invoicing & tax mapping
messages:
From: Trevor Smith <trevor@nebula.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nebula.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:14:00Z
Subject: Question on invoice entity mapping and pricing slabs for NEB-4521

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — Nebula is excited about the latency profile on Redwood's vCPU-backed instances. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of things we need for our internal PO routing and tax team before we can sign: 

- We need visibility into the pricing slab schedule (monthly consumption tiers and how overage rates apply). Is that per-account or per-entity?
- Our legal ops want the ability to split invoicing across two Nebula legal entities (US parent + EU subsidiary). Can the Order Form support line-item allocation to multiple "bill-to" entities?
- For taxes: Nebula will provide an EU VAT registration — do you require VAT-exempt language or will you invoice VAT on top?
- Finally, can you provide a draft Order Form that shows minimum commit cadence (quarterly tranches) and how proration would work on ramp-down?

I attached our standard Procurement checklist and a PO template. If it's easier, happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Trevor
Trevor Smith
Head of Procurement, Nebula AI
Attachments: Nebula_ProForma.xlsx (xlsx, 22KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Smith <trevor@nebula.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on invoice entity mapping and pricing slabs for NEB-4521

Hi Trevor — really appreciate the clear list. I've sketched a proposal below and attached a first-pass Order Form PDF that maps to NEB-4521. High-level answers: 

- Pricing slabs: we can publish the slab thresholds on a per-deal basis in the Order Form. For multi-entity accounts we support two modes: (a) consolidated consumption (single slab calculation across the account) with split billing, or (b) per-entity slab calculations (each legal entity billed and measured separately).

- Invoice split: we can accept split invoicing to two legal entities on the same Order Form. Practically this is implemented via an "Entity Allocation Appendix" that enumerates SKUs, percentages (or fixed units), and Bill-To party for each line. Our billing engine will emit separate invoice PDFs per Bill-To.

- Taxes: for EU VAT, we can apply VAT on top by default. If you provide a valid VAT registration (attachment accepted), we can zero-rate exports where applicable and apply local VAT treatment. For US entities, we will need W-9/W-8 documentation if tax withholding questions arise.

- Minimum commit cadence / proration: proposing quarterly minimums for Year 1 with an optional staircase (Q1 25%, Q2 25%, Q3 25%, Q4 25%). Proration rules: when quantity reduces mid-period we prorate the subsequent invoice; cancellation windows are 30 days notice.

Attachments: OrderForm_Draft_v1.pdf (Order Form with Entity Allocation Appendix).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marcus and Lauren — can you confirm there are no blocking constraints on the split-billing flow and whether we need additional contractual language around tax evidence?
2) Trevor — if that structure looks acceptable I can update the Order Form with the precise entity names and percentages, then circulate for DocuSign.

Happy to jump on a short call if you'd like to walk through the appendix.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-20T11:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Question on invoice entity mapping and pricing slabs for NEB-4521

Forwarding Trevor's note + my proposed approach. Marcus / Lauren — please see the attached draft Order Form (same as sent to Trevor). Quick asks from me: 

- Marcus: can we support separate invoice PDFs per bill-to and still retain the same HubSpot deal/usage attribution? Any downstream accounting implications I should flag?
- Lauren: please review the proposed Appendix language below and advise redlines we should accept vs escalate. We are trying to avoid spinning two separate agreements.

Proposed Appendix language (draft):
"Entity Allocation Appendix: The parties agree that the Products listed on the Order Form shall be allocated among the Bill-To Entities as set forth in the attached allocation table. Redwood shall issue separate invoices to each Bill-To Entity for the amounts allocated to such entity. For tax purposes, each Bill-To Entity is responsible for providing applicable tax documentation (VAT registration certificate or equivalent)."

Please add your comments inline (I can snapshot and send to Trevor afterwards).

Thanks,
Grace

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T15:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Question on invoice entity mapping and pricing slabs for NEB-4521

Grace / Lauren — quick thumbs up from Finance with some implementation notes: 

- Split invoicing is supported. We will emit distinct invoice PDFs per Bill-To entity and post a consolidated usage/charge record to the NEB-4521 deal. That keeps HubSpot attribution intact while satisfying Nebula's AP routing.
- For slab calculations: prefer consolidated consumption for simplicity unless Nebula insists on per-entity slab guarantees. Consolidated saves them money on cross-entity smoothing. If they need per-entity slab calculations we should tag as a custom billing rule (adds implementation effort).
- Tax evidence: require VAT registration doc for EU entity (nebula_vat_cert.pdf) and W-9/W-8 on file for US entity where applicable. We will add contract language that places responsibility for providing valid tax docs prior to first invoice.
- Net terms: Finance prefers Net 30 for public-sector or reseller flows, Net 45 for larger enterprises. Given Nebula's size, propose Net 45 but offer Net 30 in exchange for a 2% early-pay discount if they want.
- Attachments for our redline: I'm including an entity allocation CSV template (entity_map_template.csv) that Trevor can fill. Also recommend adding a short exhibit specifying "Billing Contact" and "Tax Contact" for each Bill-To entity.

I will prepare a small legal + billing exhibit (3–4 lines) we can drop into the Appendix and circulate. Lauren, if you want me to draft the exact exhibit text I can and Grace can share it back to the customer.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: entity_map_template.csv (csv, 1KB), nebula_vat_cert.pdf (pdf, 14KB)
